tasks.label: Verify country details and adjacent map behavior
Compare existing frontend failures before Batch 1 CSS
args:
import sys, unittest; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, 'tests'); import test_frontend_browser as tests
original_read = Path.read_text
def baseline_read(path, *args, **kwargs):
    source = original_read(path, *args, **kwargs)
    if path.name == 'beenthere-card.js':
        source = source.replace('column-gap:16px;row-gap:8px;margin-top:8px;align-items:stretch', 'gap:16px;margin-top:14px;align-items:stretch')
        source = source.replace('.search-row{max-width:420px;margin:0}', '.search-row{max-width:420px;margin-bottom:12px}')
        source = source.replace('min-width:0;padding:8px 0}.search-result img', 'min-width:0;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #31516a;border-radius:8px;background:#112b3f}.search-result img')
        source = source.replace('.region-panel .visited-country-section{border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:0}', '')
    return source
Path.read_text = baseline_read
names = ['test_failed_region_save_restores_control_and_can_retry', 'test_group_union_and_region_controls_are_read_only', 'test_hidden_region_visits_cannot_be_cleared_from_country_map', 'test_region_expansion_is_independent_and_resets_on_view_or_continent_change', 'test_sidebar_removes_only_explicit_country_visit_with_confirmation', 'test_sidebar_selection_focuses_country_and_region_without_mutation', 'test_state_click_keeps_focus_and_scroll_on_map', 'test_visited_country_expands_only_visited_regions']
suite = unittest.TestSuite(tests.PanelBrowserTests(name) for name in names)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
